findings.claim: Argus 表列 SpaceX 調整後 EBITDA 利潤率 35.3%，並與大型科技同業並列成長與利潤率
findings.excerpt: SpaceX had $22 billion in long-term debt, $24.7 billion in cash, and total equity of $2.5 billion as of December 31, 2025. The debt-to-total capitalization ratio was a steep 89.8%. However, the company generates healthy cash flow. The 2025 the adjusted EBITDA margin was 35.3%.
